steps.name: host-load-and-checkout-readonly
steps.command:
set -eu
echo REPOSITORY;pwd;git remote get-url origin;git branch --show-current;git rev-parse HEAD
echo HOST_LOAD;uptime
echo MEMORY;vm_stat | head -9
echo APP_TEST_PROCESSES
ps -axo pid,rss,etime,command | grep -E '[p]laywright test|[v]itest run|[g]radle.*Daemon|[n]ode.*vite' | head -25 || true
echo WORKTREE;git status --short
echo TIME_UTC;date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
